description_en: Queries the details of a site monitoring task by calling the DescribeSiteMonitorAttribute operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeSiteMonitorAttribute接口查询站点监控任务的详细信息
name: DescribeSiteMonitorAttribute

parameters.help_en: The ID of the monitoring task
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the returned task details include alert rules
parameters.help_zh:
返回的任务详情是否包含报警规则。

true：如果该参数的取值为true，则返回报警规则。
false（默认值）：如果该参数的取值为false，则不返回报警规则
parameters.name: include_alert

SiteMonitors.description_en: The details of the monitoring task

Address.description_en: The URL or IP address that is monitored by the task

AgentGroup.description_en: The type of detection point. Default value: PC
AgentGroup.description_zh:
探测点类型。默认为PC。
取值：

PC 固网

MOBILE 移动端

CustomSchedule.description_en: The custom monitoring schedule. You can select a time period from Monday to Sunday for monitoring
CustomSchedule.description_zh: 自定义探测周期。只能选择周一至周日的某个时间段进行探测

end_hour.description_zh:
自定义探测结束时间。

单位：小时

start_hour.description_zh:
自定义探测开始时间。

单位：小时

time_zone.description_en: The time zone of the custom monitoring schedule

Interval.description_en: The monitoring interval. Unit: minutes. Valid values: 1, 5, 15, 30, and 60
Interval.description_zh: 监控任务的周期。单位：分钟。取值：1、 5、15、30和60

OptionJson.description_en: The extended options. Each monitoring type has different extended options. For more information, see [CreateSiteMonitor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115048.html）
OptionJson.description_zh: 扩展选项。每一种探测类型有不同的扩展类型，详情请参见[CreateSiteMonitor]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/115048.html）

attempts.description_en: The number of retries after a DNS failure

access_key_id.description_en: The AccessKey ID used for Alibaba Cloud authentication. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring. We recommend that you use encrypted storage
access_key_id.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，使用阿里云鉴权时，传入的accessKey，建议使用加密存储

access_key_secret.description_en: The AccessKey secret used for Alibaba Cloud authentication. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring. We recommend that you use encrypted storage
access_key_secret.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，使用阿里云鉴权时，传入的accessKey Secret，建议使用加密存储

api_action.description_en: The API action of the request when Alibaba Cloud operations are used. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring
api_action.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，使用阿里云操作时，请求api

api_version.description_en: The API version of the request when Alibaba Cloud operations are used. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring
api_version.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，使用阿里云操作时，请求api版本

auth_style.description_en: The OAuth 2.0 authentication style. Valid values: ROA and RPC

client_id.description_en: The client ID used for client authentication in OAuth 2.0
client_id.description_zh: Oauth2.0中使用的客户端鉴权时的客户端id

client_secret.description_en: The client secret used for client authentication in OAuth 2.0
client_secret.description_zh: Oauth2.0中使用的客户端鉴权时的客户端密钥

grant_type.description_en: The grant type used in OAuth 2.0 authentication. Valid values: client_credentials and password
grant_type.description_zh: Oauth2.0认证中，使用的鉴权类型。可选值为client_credentials和password

password.description_en: The password used for HTTP Basic Authentication

region_id.description_en: The region ID of the request when Alibaba Cloud authentication is used. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring
region_id.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，使用阿里云鉴权时，请求的regionId

service_name.description_en: The service name of the request when AWS authentication is used
service_name.description_zh: 使用AWS鉴权时，请求的服务名称

session_token.description_en: The session token used for AWS authentication

token_url.description_en: The authentication server URL in OAuth 2.0

type.description_en: The authentication type. HTTP Basic Authentication is supported. Valid values: basic
type.description_zh: 鉴权信息，目前支持HTTP Basic Authentication。可选值为basic

use_cookie_session_key.description_en: Specifies whether the key is stored in the client cookie for digest authentication
use_cookie_session_key.description_zh: digest认证中，该参数指示密钥是否存储在客户端的Cookie中

username.description_en: The username used for HTTP Basic Authentication
username.description_zh: HTTP Basic Authentication使用的用户名

with_addon_resources.description_en: Specifies whether additional resources exist for the operation when Alibaba Cloud authentication is used in this step. This parameter is supported only in multi-step synthetic monitoring
with_addon_resources.description_zh: 仅在多步拨测中支持，当该步使用阿里云鉴权时，操作是否存在额外资源

browser_insecure.description_en: Specifies whether to ignore certificate errors. Valid values:
browser_insecure.description_zh:
是否忽略证书错误。取值：

false：不忽略证书错误。
true：忽略证书错误

browser_task_version.description_en: The browser monitoring version. Valid values:
browser_task_version.description_zh:
浏览器拨测版本。取值：

1：单页拨测。
2：多页拨测

cookie.description_en: The cookie used to send the HTTP request

diagnosis_mtr.description_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic MTR network diagnostics after a task failure. Valid values:
diagnosis_mtr.description_zh:
是否开启任务失败后的自动MTR网络诊断。取值：
false：不开启自动MTR网络诊断。
true  开启自动MTR网络诊断

diagnosis_ping.description_en: Specifies whether to enable automatic PING network latency detection after a task failure. Valid values:
diagnosis_ping.description_zh:
是否开启任务失败后自动PING网络延时探测。取值：
false：不开启自动PING网络延时探测。
true：开启自动PING网络延时探测

dns_match_rule.description_en: The DNS matching rule. Valid values:
dns_match_rule.description_zh:
DNS的匹配规则。取值：

IN_DNS：期望解析的别名或IP地址均在DNS应答中。
DNS_IN：所有的DNS应答都出现在期望解析的别名或IP地址中。
EQUAL：DNS应答和期望解析的别名或IP地址完全相同。
ANY：DNS应答和期望解析的别名或IP地址有交集

dns_server.description_en: The IP address of the DNS server
dns_server.description_zh:
DNS服务器的IP地址。

仅适用于DNS探测类型

dns_type.description_en: The DNS resolution type. This parameter applies only to the DNS monitoring type. Valid values:
dns_type.description_zh:
DNS解析类型。仅适用于DNS探测类型。取值：
A：指定主机名或域名对应的IP地址。
CNAME：将多个域名映射到另外一个域名。
NS：指定域名由某个DNS服务器解析。
MX：将域名指向一个邮件服务器地址。
TXT：主机名或域名的说明。文本长度限制512字节，通常用做SPF（Sender Policy Framework）记录，即反垃圾邮件

empty_message.description_en: Specifies whether to allow the WebSocket task to return no message or an empty message. Valid values:
empty_message.description_zh:
是否允许WebSocket任务不返回消息或返回空消息。取值：
false（默认）：否。
true： 是

enable_packet_capture.description_en: Specifies whether to enable packet capture for this task

expect_value.description_en: The alias or address to be resolved
expect_value.description_zh:
待解析的别名或地址。

该参数仅适用于DNS探测类型

failure_rate.description_zh:
丢包率。

该参数仅适用于PING探测类型

hops.description_en: The number of hops for traceroute diagnostics when a PING task fails
hops.description_zh: 指定PING任务失败时，执行traceroute诊断的跳数

host_binding.description_en: The custom host for HTTP tasks. The format is ip1,ip2:address, and multiple mappings can be configured. The left side of the colon contains A records or CNAMEs that the domain name can be resolved to, separated by commas. The right side of the colon is the domain name
host_binding.description_zh: HTTP任务自定义host，格式为ip1,ip2:address，可以配置多行映射。冒号左边是域名可被解析的A记录或者cname，使用逗号隔开，冒号右边是域名

host_binding_type.description_en: The method by which the custom host takes effect. Valid values: 0 (random) and 1 (round-robin)
host_binding_type.description_zh: host_binding_type的可选值为0或1，指示自定义host的生效方式。0表示随机，1表示轮询

http_method.description_en: The HTTP request method. Valid values:
http_method.description_zh:
HTTP请求方法。取值：
get 
post
head

icmp_timeout_millis.description_en: The timeout period for a single PING request in ICMP-based PING tasks. Unit: milliseconds
icmp_timeout_millis.description_zh: 指定使用ICMP协议进行的PING任务的单次PING超时时间，单位为毫秒

ip_network.description_en: The network type of the task. Valid values: v4, v6, and auto. Default value: v4
ip_network.description_zh: ip_network指示该任务的网络类型，可选值为v4，v6，auto，默认值为v4

isBase64Encode.description_en: Specifies whether to store the password after Base64 decoding. Valid values:
isBase64Encode.description_zh:
是否对密码进行base64解码存储。取值：
true：对密码进行base64解码存储。
false：不对密码进行base64解码存储

match_rule.description_en: Specifies whether to include alert rules. Valid values:
match_rule.description_zh:
是否包含报警规则。取值：
0：是。
1：否

min_tls_version.description_en: The minimum TLS version. TLS 1.2 and later are supported by default. TLS 1.0 and 1.1 are disabled. You can change the configuration if you still need to support them
min_tls_version.description_zh: 最低TLS版本。默认支持TLS1.2及以上版本，TLS1.0和1.1已被禁用，如仍需支持可更改配置

password.description_en: The password for the SMTP, POP3, or FTP monitoring type

ping_num.description_en: The number of heartbeats for the PING monitoring type

ping_port.description_en: The PING port. This parameter applies to TCP PING

ping_type.description_en: The PING protocol type. Valid values:
ping_type.description_zh:
PING协议类型。取值：

icmp

tcp

udp

port.description_en: The port for the TCP, UDP, SMTP, or POP3 monitoring type

private_crt_file_name.description_en: The name of the private certificate file

quic_enabled.description_en: Specifies whether the browser monitoring task uses the QUIC protocol. Valid values:
quic_enabled.description_zh:
浏览器拨测是否使用quic协议，取值：
true，使用quic协议
false，不实用quic协议
默认值为false

request_content.description_en: The request content for the HTTP monitoring type

request_format.description_en: The format of the HTTP request content. Valid values:
request_format.description_zh:
HTTP请求内容格式。取值：
hex：十六进制格式。
txt：文本格式

response_format.description_en: The format of the HTTP response content. Valid values:
response_format.description_zh:
HTTP响应内容格式。取值：
hex：十六进制格式。
txt：文本格式

retry_delay.description_en: The number of retries after a monitoring failure

safe_link.description_en: This parameter takes effect for SMTP tasks. When set to 1, a secure connection is used. Default value: 0
safe_link.description_zh: 对SMTP类型的任务生效。设置为1时，使用安全连接。默认值为0

screen_shot.description_en: Specifies whether to enable page screenshots

scroll_end.description_en: For browser monitoring tasks, specifies whether to scroll to the bottom of the page after it is opened
scroll_end.description_zh: 当任务为浏览器探测任务时，scroll_end代表打开页面之后是否滚动到页面最下端

trace_region.description_en: The deployment region of the target application when integrating with Managed Service for OpenTelemetry
trace_region.description_zh: 设置与可观测链路OpenTelemetry版本集成时，目标应用的部署地域

trace_type.description_en: Settings for the Tracing Analysis protocol used when integrating with Managed Service for OpenTelemetry
trace_type.description_zh:
设置与可观测链路OpenTelemetry版本集成时，使用的链路追踪协议。
可选值为
OpenTelemetry
Zipkin
Jaeger

traffic_hijack_element_count.description_en: When a redirect occurs, if the number of resources loaded by the browser exceeds this value, traffic hijacking is considered to have occurred. When this value is 0, no verification is performed. Default value: 0
traffic_hijack_element_count.description_zh: 当发生重定向时，如果浏览器加载资源数超过这个值，则认为发生流量劫持。当该值为0时，不进行校验，默认值为0

use_private_crt.description_en: Specifies whether to use a private certificate

use_ssl.description_en: Specifies whether to use an SSL connection when performing TCP tasks
use_ssl.description_zh: 执行TCP任务时是否进行SSL连接
use_ssl.title_en: 执行TCP任务时是否进行SSL连接
use_ssl.title_zh: 执行TCP任务时是否进行SSL连接

username.description_en: The username for FTP, SMTP, or POP3

waitTime_after_completion.description_en: The additional wait time after the page is opened in a browser monitoring task
waitTime_after_completion.description_zh: 浏览器拨测任务中，页面打开后的额外等待时间

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the monitoring task

TaskName.description_en: The name of the monitoring task

TaskState.description_en: The status of the monitoring task. Valid values:
TaskState.description_zh:
监控任务的状态。取值：

1：启用。
2：禁用

TaskType.description_en: The type of the monitoring task. Site monitoring tasks support the following types: HTTP(S), PING, TCP, UDP, DNS, SMTP, POP3, and FTP
TaskType.description_zh: 监控任务类型。目前站点监控任务的类型包括：HTTP（S）、PING、TCP、UDP、DNS、SMTP、POP3、FTP

VpcConfig.description_en: The VPC configuration of the internal network monitoring task
VpcConfig.description_zh: 内网拨测任务的VPC配置信息

Region.description_en: The region where the target site of the internal network monitoring task resides
Region.description_zh: 内网拨测任务的目标站点所在地域

SecurityGroupId.description_en: The ID of the security group to which the internal network monitoring task is restricted
SecurityGroupId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务受限于的安全组id

VpcId.description_en: The ID of the VPC to which the internal network monitoring task is attached
VpcId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务挂载的vpc id

VswitchId.description_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the internal network monitoring task is attached
VswitchId.description_zh: 该内网拨测任务挂载的vswitch id

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
